description: Land Acquisition - Thanahena, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District and amendments to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2094/1 of 22.10.2018, Mahara D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, including detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, claimants, and acquisition procedures for public purposes. It falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
